CHANGE g0019 ADDED part 1/1 encoding=literal # Spoiler Spans With the flag `MD_FLAG_SPOILERS`, MD4C enables recognition of inline spoiler spans using the `||text||` syntax (popularized by Telegram and Discord). A spoiler span is content wrapped in exactly two consecutive pipe characters (`||`) on each side. The content is intended to be hidden by default and revealed on user interaction (tap, hover, click, etc.). Rendering of the hidden state is the application's responsibility; the HTML renderer wraps the content in `` tags. ## Basic recognition ```````````````````````````````` example ||Hello, world!|| .

Hello, world!

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` Spoilers may appear inline alongside normal text: ```````````````````````````````` example This is normal text with ||hidden content|| revealed here. .

This is normal text with hidden content revealed here.

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` Multiple independent spoiler spans in the same paragraph: ```````````````````````````````` example ||first|| and ||second|| .

first and second

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` A spoiler span at the very start and end of a paragraph: ```````````````````````````````` example ||entire paragraph is a spoiler|| .

entire paragraph is a spoiler

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ## Flag required Without `MD_FLAG_SPOILERS` the `||` sequence is treated as literal text: ```````````````````````````````` example ||hidden|| .

||hidden||

. ```````````````````````````````` ## Nested inline spans inside a spoiler Emphasis inside a spoiler: ```````````````````````````````` example ||nested *emphasis*|| .

nested emphasis

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` Strong emphasis inside a spoiler: ```````````````````````````````` example ||**bold** and _italic_ together|| .

bold and italic together

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` Inline code inside a spoiler: ```````````````````````````````` example ||spoiler with `code`|| .

spoiler with code

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` A link inside a spoiler: ```````````````````````````````` example ||spoiler with [a link](http://example.com)|| .

spoiler with a link

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` Strikethrough inside a spoiler (requires both flags): ```````````````````````````````` example ||~~strikethrough inside spoiler~~|| .

strikethrough inside spoiler

. --fspoilers --fstrikethrough ```````````````````````````````` A spoiler inside strikethrough: ```````````````````````````````` example ~~del with ||spoiler|| inside~~ .

del with spoiler inside

. --fspoilers --fstrikethrough ```````````````````````````````` ## Suppression inside code spans and code blocks Pipe characters inside a code span are not recognized as spoiler delimiters: ```````````````````````````````` example `code with ||pipes||` .

code with ||pipes||

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` Similarly inside a fenced code block: ```````````````````````````````` example ``` ||not a spoiler|| ``` . 
||not a spoiler||
. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` And inside an indented code block: ```````````````````````````````` example ||not a spoiler|| . 
||not a spoiler||
. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ## Unmatched delimiters A lone `||` with no matching closer is left as literal text: ```````````````````````````````` example ||unclosed spoiler .

||unclosed spoiler

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` A lone closer with no preceding opener is also left as literal text: ```````````````````````````````` example unclosed spoiler|| .

unclosed spoiler||

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ## Backslash escaping A backslash before the first pipe escapes it, breaking the `||` pair and preventing spoiler recognition: ```````````````````````````````` example \||not a spoiler|| .

||not a spoiler||

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ## Paragraph boundary A spoiler cannot span a paragraph break (same rule as emphasis): ```````````````````````````````` example ||starts here ends here|| .

||starts here

ends here||

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ## Soft line break inside a spoiler A soft line break within the same block is permitted: ```````````````````````````````` example ||multi line spoiler|| .

multi line spoiler

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ## Empty spoiler Two consecutive `||` pairs produce an empty spoiler span: ```````````````````````````````` example |||| .

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ## Block-level contexts ### ATX headings ```````````````````````````````` example # ||heading spoiler|| .

heading spoiler

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ```````````````````````````````` example ## ||level two|| .

level two

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ### Block quotes ```````````````````````````````` example > ||hidden in a quote|| .

hidden in a quote

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` Nested block quotes: ```````````````````````````````` example > > ||nested quote spoiler|| .

nested quote spoiler

. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ### Unordered lists ```````````````````````````````` example - ||list item spoiler|| - normal item .
  • list item spoiler
  • normal item
. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ### Ordered lists ```````````````````````````````` example 1. ||first item|| 2. normal item .
  1. first item
  2. normal item
. --fspoilers ```````````````````````````````` ### Task lists (requires `MD_FLAG_TASKLISTS`) ```````````````````````````````` example - [ ] ||task item spoiler|| - [x] done .
  • task item spoiler
  • done
. --fspoilers --ftasklists ```````````````````````````````` ### Tables (requires `MD_FLAG_TABLES`) A spoiler inside a table cell: ```````````````````````````````` example | A | B | |---|---| | ||spoiler|| | baz | .
A B
spoiler baz
. --fspoilers --ftables ```````````````````````````````` Spoiler parsing must not interfere with table cell boundary detection: ```````````````````````````````` example x |- |||||||||| .
x
||
. --fspoilers --github ```````````````````````````````` ## Interaction with other extensions ### Wiki links (requires `MD_FLAG_WIKILINKS`) A spoiler inside the display portion of a wiki link: ```````````````````````````````` example [[target|display with ||spoiler||]] .

display with spoiler

. --fspoilers --fwiki-links ```````````````````````````````` Wiki links with a `|` separator must not be mistaken for spoiler delimiters: ```````````````````````````````` example [[foo|bar]] .

bar

. --fspoilers --fwiki-links ```````````````````````````````` A wiki link whose label contains an unrelated `|` character: ```````````````````````````````` example [[foo|bar|baz]] .

bar|baz

. --fspoilers --fwiki-links ````````````````````````````````
